organizationId.description: Unique identifier of the organization to which users are being invited. Required.

teamIds.description: List of unique identifiers of the teams within the organization that invited users will be added to.

emails.description: List of email addresses to invite to the organization. Each address will receive an invitation email.

redirectUrl.description: URL to redirect the user to after accepting the invitation. If omitted, users are redirected to the default sign-in page.

invitedBy.description: Unique identifier of the user sending the invitations.

expirationDate.description: Date and time when the invitations expire. Defaults to 5 days after creation if omitted.
